To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) Eulerian mean Ekman pumping is not the only factor responsible for low biological activity and low vertical mixing in the subtropical oceans; (2) in the subtropical ocean, the eddy driven circulation acts in such a way that the Eulerian mean Ek-man downwelling is largely canceled; and (3) this eddy driven circulation is not a compensation mechanism, but rather a rectification mechanism that acts on the Eulerian mean circulation.
the climatological mean Ekman downwells in the subtropics are cancelled by eddy-driven upwelling.

eddy cancellation of the Ekman cell in the subtropical ocean gyres is a real phenomenon that can explain the low biological activity in these regions, and that it is not the same as eddy compensation.

the role of mesoscale oceanic eddies in the formation and maintenance of large-scale density distributions.
the role of eddy cancellation in subtropical gyres and how this process may affect the biological productivity of these regions.

In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the Eulerian mean downwelling in the model subtropical gyre is largely cancelled by the eddy-driven Ekman upwelling.
eddy cancellation is the dominant effect of eddys on the Eulerian-mean circulation in the subtropical ocean, and that eddy compensation is a secondary effect.
the Eulerian-mean circulation in the subtropical oceans is dominated by eddy cancellation of Ekman pumping and not by Ekman upwelling, as is commonly believed.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the Eulerian-mean down-welling associated with climatological wind-stress curl is not a necessary condition for the low biological activity of the subtropical gyre.
eddies are not only important for biological activity, but also important for the Eulerian mean flow in the subtropical oceans.
the subtropical ocean has a strong eddy-driven circulation.
The main takeaway from our work is that
eddy-driven cancellation of the Eulerian-mean circulation should be considered in any discussion of subtropical gyre dynamics.
the Eulerian mean is an insufficient description for the circulation in the subtropical ocean.
